name: ship-a-erp
description: Work in your Ship a ERP business system from ChatGPT: find customers, invoices and orders, draft bills from a PDF, create invoices, quotes and tasks, and log your work, with your own permissions.

interface.shortDescription: Run your business ERP in chat
interface.longDescription:
This plugin connects ChatGPT to Ship a ERP, the business management system (ERP) a company uses to run its sales, purchasing, invoicing, projects and accounting. People who work in Ship a ERP can look up their company's records and do their day-to-day operations work from ChatGPT, signed in as themselves.

What you can do:
- Look things up: customers, contacts, suppliers, products, invoices, vendor bills, quotes, purchase and sales orders, projects and tasks.
- See what's on your plate: your open tasks, your opportunities, and what waits for your approval.
- Ask about receivables and payables: what customers owe, what the company owes suppliers, and sales invoiced this month.
- Hand over a supplier's bill (PDF or photo) and it's recorded as a draft with the document attached.
- Draft invoices, quotes and purchase orders; add customers, contacts, suppliers and tasks; log time and calls.
- If you allow it: approve bills, issue and email invoices, send purchase orders and void invoices. ChatGPT asks you before each of these.

Who it's for: members of a company that uses Ship a ERP, once their administrator has turned on AI apps for the workspace.

How it works and its limits: you sign in with your Ship a ERP account and choose one workspace and what ChatGPT may do there (only look things up, also create drafts, or also approve and send). It acts with your own permissions and nothing more; your administrator can turn it off or limit it for everyone. It works in one workspace per connection. It can't move money, take payments or change settings, users or permissions. Every request is logged and every change appears in the workspace's audit log.
defaultPrompt: Which customer invoices are overdue in Ship a ERP, and how much do we owe suppliers?
Record this supplier bill in Ship a ERP as a draft.
What's waiting for my approval in Ship a ERP?

positive.description: Shows the signed-in person, the connected workspace and what the plugin may do there
positive.prompt: Which company am I connected to in Ship a ERP, and what can you do there?
positive.expected_behavior: Names the reviewer (AI App Reviewer), the ACME Corp workspace, the access level chosen at sign-in and the person's permissions.

positive.description: Lists the person's open work and pending approvals
positive.prompt: What's on my plate in Ship a ERP?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the person's open project tasks by due date, the opportunities assigned to them and anything waiting for their approval, or says there is nothing pending.

positive.description: Summarizes receivables and payables in the workspace currency
positive.prompt: How much do customers owe us in Ship a ERP, and which invoices are overdue?
positive.expected_behavior: Gives the total of open and overdue customer invoices in the workspace currency and lists the most overdue invoices with their customers.

positive.description: Finds customers by search and reads one record
positive.prompt: Search Ship a ERP for customers and show me the details of the first one.
positive.expected_behavior: Lists demo customers with links to them, then shows the first customer's details (contact information and contacts).

positive.description: Creates a draft invoice without posting or sending it
positive.prompt: Create a draft invoice in Ship a ERP for the first customer you find: 2 hours of consulting at 100 each.
positive.expected_behavior: Creates a Draft invoice for that customer with a total of 200 before tax and returns its number and link; nothing is posted to the books and no email is sent.

negative.description: General business advice with no need for the person's records
negative.prompt: What are good practices for setting payment terms with new customers?

negative.description: An invoice for a personal or one-off use, outside the company's system
negative.prompt: Make me an invoice template in a table that I can copy into a Word document.

negative.description: Moving money, which the plugin doesn't do
negative.prompt: Pay our supplier 500 dollars from the company bank account.

publication.release_notes: First release: look up records, see your work and receivables, draft invoices, quotes, purchase orders and vendor bills, and (if you allow it) approve, issue and send them.

es-ES.subtitle: Tu ERP, desde ChatGPT
es-ES.description:
Ship a ERP es un sistema de gestión empresarial (ERP) para llevar ventas, compras, facturación, proyectos y contabilidad en un solo espacio de trabajo. Este plugin permite a quienes ya trabajan en Ship a ERP hacerlo desde ChatGPT, con su propia cuenta.

Qué puedes hacer:
- Buscar clientes, contactos, proveedores, productos, facturas, facturas de proveedor, cotizaciones, órdenes de compra y de venta, proyectos y tareas.
- Ver tus tareas abiertas, tus oportunidades y lo que espera tu aprobación.
- Consultar cuentas por cobrar y por pagar, y las ventas facturadas del mes.
- Entregar la factura de un proveedor (PDF o foto) y registrarla como borrador con el documento adjunto.
- Crear borradores de facturas, cotizaciones y órdenes de compra; agregar clientes, contactos, proveedores y tareas; registrar horas y llamadas.
- Si lo permites: aprobar facturas de proveedor, emitir y enviar facturas, enviar órdenes de compra y anular facturas. ChatGPT te pregunta antes de cada una.

Para quién: miembros de una empresa que usa Ship a ERP, cuando su administrador activó las apps de IA en el espacio de trabajo.

Cómo funciona y sus límites: inicias sesión con tu cuenta de Ship a ERP y eliges un espacio de trabajo y qué puede hacer ChatGPT allí. Actúa con tus permisos y nada más. No mueve dinero, no cobra ni cambia configuraciones, usuarios o permisos.
